C0224.title: Prosecution Team Breaks Down Typical E-Commerce Fraud Schemes: How to Avoid the Traps
C0224.summary: A counterfeit-store case handled by the Tongzhou District Procuratorate in Beijing showed that Xu used relatives' information to obtain a business license and bought others' identity details, bank cards, and phone cards for company registration and online-store setup. Xu used fake orders to create the appearance of strong sales before selling counterfeit baby formula at low prices. In September 2024, Xu was sentenced to one year in prison and fined RMB 40,000 for selling goods bearing counterfeit registered trademarks.
